text:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated tool-exec latency and error-rate spike on action-runner pool. 95th latency > 8s, fncall error-rate 12% in last 5m. Auto-throttle triggered. Paging eng-oncall.

alice_oncall: I see it. Confirming user-facing errors?

bob_sre: Errors correlate with structured-output processing queue growth. KV cache pressure + unusually long serialization times.

carol_prodeng: Can we scope a fast mitigation that avoids a full rollback? Recommend temporary restrict of external function/tool invocation and fall back to text-only responses for lower tiers.

dan_support: We already have ~6 customer tickets reporting timeouts on tool-based features. Most on free and dev plans.

alice_oncall: Ok. Plan: 1) immediate toggle - disable external-tool/execution for free and trial plans; 2) set response-mode=plaintext for all tiers for next 30m; 3) monitor latency and error-rate. If stable, gradually re-enable with stricter quotas.

bob_sre: Commands to push (I can run):
```
# API toggle to restrict tool exec by plan
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/feature-toggle \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"tool_exec.allowed_plans","value":["paid","enterprise"]}'

# set response mode to text-only
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/config \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"key":"runtime.response_mode","value":"text-only"}'
```

carol_prodeng: Add a temporary routing fallback to lower-cost, lower-latency model variant for structured-heavy endpoints: route model->redwood-small for detected toolcalls. That reduces KV load.

dan_support: I'll draft a short customer note: "We're temporarily restricting tool-based actions on free accounts to improve platform stability. Paid customers unaffected; we'll update in 30 minutes." Put link here once created.

alice_oncall: I'm going to apply the toggles now. Bob, please stand by to rollback. Dan, please start the customer note and mark affected tenants. Eve, I'll hand off once we stabilize.

bob_sre: Watching metrics. Setting alert: if tool-exec error-rate < 3% and p95 latency < 1.5s for 2 consecutive 5m windows, we can re-open exec for trials with reduced quota.

incident-bot: ACTION: feature-toggle applied by alice_oncall at 1735560100. response_mode set to text-only. Tool-exec allowed_plans updated -> [paid, enterprise].

alice_oncall: Confirming immediate drop in queue depth. p95 down from 8.3s -> 2.1s in last 2m. Errors down to ~4%. Good progress.

carol_prodeng: Good. Keep routing fallback in place for 20m. We'll prepare a canary can re-enable for a small cohort (10 tenants) on paid plan first.

dan_support: Customer note: https://redwood.support/incident/1735559999 — posted draft. Notifying affected users and added temporary workaround steps.

eve_next_oncall: I am taking the pager. I'll monitor for next 60m and own re-enable checklist. If p95 stays <1.5s and errors <3% for 10m, I'll start staged re-enable: 1) enable tool-exec for paid canary; 2) after 10m, widen to paid; 3) after 30m, consider trials.

alice_oncall: Handoff ack. Leaving ops channel open, I'll stay available for rollback. :thumbsup:

bob_sre: Added dashboard widgets and a temporary synthetic that runs tool-call flows every 30s. If any regression, we auto-disable with same flag.

alice_oncall: Closing thread for initial mitigation — monitoring ongoing. If anything changes ping @eve_next_oncall.
